notes.title: Oculus Touch support update and fix
notes.content:
Sorry for updating late.
1.Oculus touch can support the game well, the player won't jump when just touching the oculus touch trigger!
2. when restarting game, player sometimes can not hold the ski stick. It has been fixed in the update.

tags.bug: 1.Oculus touch can support the game well, the player won't jump when just touching the oculus touch trigger!
2. when restarting game, player sometimes can not hold the ski stick. It has been fixed in the update.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
1.Now the birds are easier to be dodged, and they get a sound effect.
2.Correct show of Scores.
3.A powerful jumping.
4.It becomes easier for players to go straight, even when they are heavily crashed by terrain or obstacles.
